main_text.p: eus nemo. Neverò tu idem contra conscientiam tuam de iis sentire te debere quiriteris, age copendiario disputationis tuæ examine per Dei gratiam sum effecturus, ut nec præfatos theologos nec me ppositum habere aliud, quàm veritati in NA-TURA & SCRIPTURA divinitus revelatæ patrocinari, clarissime intelligas. Pone itaque præjudicium, pone affectus, pone animo præceptas opiniones, quæ nocent judicio, & ex re judica. Faxit Deus ter Opt. Max., ut sincero ac constanti veritatis, pietatis & mutuæ charitatis studio ardeamus omnes, & tandem in Christo Jesu salutem consequamur, Amen.

page.notes: The text is partly faint; the faint lines in the lower half of the page are show-through from the reverse side and are not transcribed. The tailpiece ornament (–§(o)§–) is not transcribed. Possible misreadings: "ppositum" likely "propositum" as printed; "Neverò" and "ppositum" copied as printed.
